notes.title: HotFix Notes Version 1.1.1
notes.content:
Reverted maximum audio sample rate increase.

Added 3 new Photo Mode filters.

notes.title: Free Expansion & Supporter Pack Update
notes.content:
Free expansion including 8 more songs and areas. 

Supporter pack is now available featuring model viewer, music player, and photo mode. 

Updated song playback to continue playing from where they left off for a short duration after leaving a "song area" and repeat if you hang around.  

Added frame rate cap option

Increased maximum audio sample rate

Various bug fixes
